svg.text: 8. A second issuer: the EDC Issuer Service

What run.sh checks, by the numbers of its header (steps 1 and 2 make the keys and start everything). The STS calls, the presentation queries behind every DSP request, and the data plane signaling are left out. Each
frame stops at its first failed check.
3. CredentialRequestMessage, asked through the Identity API
CredentialMessage to each Storage API (DCP 6.5): ISSUED
catalog; FINALIZED; STARTED; Portitor pulls the data, equal to the original
HealthDCAT-AP datasets checked against the bundle; FINALIZED; EDC pulls; Portitor pushes, COMPLETED

8. negotiate the offer for compliant participants
9. store EDC's compliance and legal person credentials (signed by gaiax_test_onboarding.py) [Identity API]
each provider offers data only for holders of InteropTestCredential (level basic)
11. both negotiate the other's offer before holding it
13. both negotiate again: FINALIZED both ways, each pulls
TERMINATED: Portitor read the revoked status, or EDC presented nothing
16. revoke one participant's membership, then the other's [management API]
17. requests of the revoked side are refused, both ways
